model.name: Parent-notion authority — stored-parent (ownerIor|parent) vs forward-scan parent must have ONE declared authoritative notion; consumers declare which, no silent mix (analysis-first)
model.description: PARENT-NOTION DISCREPANCY (analysis-first, routed by expert via PO; NO fix — measurement + architect chain-model read). A unit has MULTIPLE 'parent' notions that DISAGREE, and nothing declares which is authoritative: (a) STORED-PARENT = ownerIor OR model.parent (the mint/storage parent), itself SPLIT across two fields; (b) FORWARD-SCAN parent = whoever lists this uuid in a forward array (tasks/useCases/methods/implementations/tests/coveredRequirements/...). MEASURED: robbin-expert 889/3439 owned = 26% disagree (FWD_SCAN reverse-parent); robbin-req independent repro 286/1374 owned = 20.8% (ownerIor||parent as stored; population differs by method — same CLASS, same magnitude; the exact FWD_SCAN definition is the architect's chain-model read to fix). DISAGREEMENT SPLITS INTO THREE SUB-CLASSES (robbin-req characterization): (1) 177/286 (62%) STORED-BUT-NO-FORWARD-PARENT — a stored parent claims the unit but NO forward array points to it = a WIRING GAP (existence!=connection; the write-side dual R37.29 already guards); (2) 65/286 (23%) SINGLE-FORWARD != STORED — exactly one unit wires it, a DIFFERENT unit than the stored parent = genuine two-different-parents; (3) 44/286 (15%) MULTI-FORWARD — several units wire it = ambiguous forward-parent. By KIND the disagreers are chain-link units (Requirement 104, Class 46, UseCase 36, Test 35, Method 23) + PII (Phone 16/Address 6/Email 1) + Bug 12/Task 7. Already MIXED in one surface: the /trace breadcrumb (server.ts:3096-3116) prefers ownerIor then falls to a FWD_SCAN when ownerIor empty. This requirement does NOT rule which is authoritative — it NAMES the notions, requires ONE declared authoritative (architect chain-model read), triages the 3 sub-classes (stale-wiring vs legitimate dual-meaning), and requires downstream consumers to declare which notion they read and NOT silently mix.

model.architectRuling: architect design-r37.32-parent-notion-authority.md (f0c6b06e1), 2026-08-31: AUTHORITATIVE = the FORWARD-CHAIN edge (who forward-references the unit; chain is forward-only by Rule 1). ownerIor + model.parent are DENORMALIZED BACK-REF views that DRIFTED — the 20.8% disagreement IS the drift (the whole-session stored-copy-nothing-keeps-true disease). ownerIor SHOULD be the inverse of the forward edge; model.parent is the legacy back-ref (for a Task = the nav-Sprint, a LEGIT different concern per Rule 1). ownerIor(24)-vs-model.parent(1350) = a 3rd copy = collapse to one. CURE (post-freeze/post-scrub, NO chain-migration during the PII scrub): DERIVE the back-ref from forward refs at READ-time (reverse-index) = kills drift by construction, single-source. COORDINATE R37.29 + R37.32 + the perf reverse-parent-index into ONE forward-single-source mechanism, not 3; the 62% wiring-gap fix RIDES R37.29 (no parallel guard).

The ownerIor references in src/ts/scenario/*.ts (WebItem/message-unit/AddressIndex/CompanyIndex) are MINT-TIME WRITES, not credit READS. => NO live false-credit bug FOUND at grep level. If any credit path is later found reading ownerIor => a live false-credit bug (62% wiring-gap wearing green = phantom-coverage at the chain layer). ★ CONFIRMED BY TWO INDEPENDENT METHODS 2026-08-31 (confirm-with-independent-method): robbin-req grep-level + architect READ THE RUNTIME CREDIT FUNCTION step-evidence.ts:evidenceForStep (the implementing/testing completeness path) = walks the FORWARD chain EXCLUSIVELY (task.coveredRequirements -> r.useCases[] -> uc.method -> M.implementations[] -> im.tests[] -> Test; shippedImpl=markerPending===false; coveredByTest=TWO-KEYED Test.implementations[] back-refs Impl AND status==pass) with ZERO ownerIor/model.parent reads.
